unowned_internal_bridge_rule: At most6connector hops from an inside road through unowned roadways to the first inside road. Stop immediately at an owned outside/perimeter road. This applies canonical PN downstream-owner semantics without changing player ownership.
terminal_rule: Freeway chain tails from pinned control mapping, plus inside road links having no outgoing physical connectors. A disappearance elsewhere is unknown removal, not a completed crossing. Last records at simulation end are right-censored.

limitations.issue: Fixed whole-link spatial boundary includes through and external-destination vehicles while they share31/68/69/121/124.
limitations.treatment: They are inside until a listed outward edge is crossed. No route-identity-dependent stock weight; this is a deliberate spatial area.

limitations.issue: Natural VISSIM removals (e.g. incomplete lane change) can disappear from an inside link.
limitations.treatment: Count disappearance as completed only with endpoint/terminal evidence; report unknown_removal separately.

limitations.issue: Five-second FZP sampling can skip a short outside excursion and return.
limitations.treatment: Report observed crossing count and missing/ambiguous transitions; do not assert exact events without transition reconstruction or higher-resolution logging.

limitations.issue: Model reservoirs may combine physical links on both sides of this area.
limitations.treatment: Do not assign binary model membership by name; expose mixed memberships and derive movement transfers before changing live objective.
